subject: Nimbus Health - secure POC subsidy request & evidence plan
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Eva Moreno <eva@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Request: Private VPC POC subsidy and evidence path

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the ability to run inside our VPC. We are ready to run a 6-week Private VPC POC but need two things to move forward quickly:

1) A short-term subsidy/top-up of usage credits to cover expected GPU consumption during the POC (our security team requires the POC to be in an isolated VPC which increases cost).
2) A clear list of security/compliance artifacts we can share with internal auditors (SOC 2 attestation, encryption KMS flow, data retention settings, and a simple network diagram).

I attached a one-page SOC2 summary and a rough POC scope. Can Redwood provide a one-time consumable credit package (or discounted reserved capacity) and the evidence checklist? We can sign a short MOU if that helps.

Goal: start POC the week of Nov 15th.

Cheers,
Samir
Samir Patel
Director, Product Engineering
Nimbus Health

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Request: Private VPC POC subsidy and evidence path

Hi Samir — appreciate the clear ask and the timeline.

Ben (security/SE) and Karthik (acct exec) are cc'd — Ben will confirm the evidence package and Karthik & I will coordinate the commercial side. Quick answers up front:

- We can provide a one-time POC subsidy (amount to be confirmed) or a short reserved burst with a discounted rate for 6 weeks.
- We'll produce the SOC2/DPAs and a network diagram; Ben will list anything else the auditors typically ask for.

Ben, can you review the attached SOC2 summary and confirm what we can deliver pre-POC? Laura from finance will need to approve any subsidy amount — looping her in the next note.

Thanks — I'll aim to get an initial commercial proposal and evidence checklist by EOD Tuesday.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>, Eva Moreno <eva@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:22:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: Private VPC POC subsidy and evidence path

Thanks — dug into the SOC2 summary Samir attached. Quick checklist we can provide before kickoff:

- SOC 2 attestation (redacted) PDF for our control environment (we can provide within 24 hours).
- Data flow diagram and private VPC network diagram (1 page).
- KMS integration overview and key rotation policy summary.
- Data retention & purge workflow for cached KV/prefixes used during inference.
- Audit log snapshot for the trial account (sample export).

Operational note: for a Private VPC POC we typically see 2–3x the token compute due to data staging and model warmups; estimate attached in spreadsheet. If we grant a subsidy we prefer a signed short MOU that limits use to the POC scope and includes a simple SLA.

I attached an initial MOU template and the usage estimate. Recommend approving a $12k consumable credit for a 6-week isolated POC (covers estimated GPU hours with 20% buffer). If Finance wants to approve a smaller subsidy + discounted overage, we can do a hybrid.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Security & Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: Private VPC POC subsidy and evidence path

Priyom — reviewed Ben's estimate and Nimbus's ask. A few points from Finance:

- We can approve a one-time $8,000 consumable subsidy against the NIM-2026-471 opportunity contingent on a signed MOU that limits usage to the POC scope.
- If Nimbus signs a 3-month reserved capacity (small commit), we can increase the subsidy to $12,000 — would need a short commercial addendum.
- Please route the MOU through legal; we prefer Redwood's standard POC terms plus an annex for data residency and audit access.

Samir — if $8k works for you we can issue the subsidy immediately after the MOU is signed. If you want the $12k path we can propose the reserved-commit pricing in parallel.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Priyom/Laura/Ben — thanks for the fast turnaround.

We can accept the $8k consumable subsidy and will sign the MOU this week. We also want the option to move to the $12k reserved-commit if the POC shows promise; please include the optional addendum.

Next steps for alignment:
- Please send the MOU and the evidence package links (SOC2 redacted PDF, network diagram, KMS flow) to infra@nimbushealth.com.
- We'll have internal security sign-off within 3 business days after receiving those artifacts.
- Targeting Nov 16th as a start date.

Appreciate the help — looking forward to the POC.

Best,
Samir
